Through scenario-based exercises, case studies and peer collaboration, participants build practical strategies they can apply immediately.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Securing AI Strategy
Workshop FAQ
Real questions from real professionals who passed.
Here's
how we answer them.
Who should attend the ISC2 Securing AI Workshop?
The ISC2 Securing AI Workshop is designed for cybersecurity professionals, IT security managers, risk officers and technology leaders responsible for securing AI implementations within their organizations. It is especially valuable for professionals preparing to lead AI security initiatives, influence stakeholders on AI risk and guide teams through emerging AI threats. A background in information security is recommended, though no specific certification is required to attend.
What are the prerequisites for the ISC2 Securing AI Workshop?
There are no formal prerequisites for this workshop. Participants should have a foundational understanding of information security principles. Deep technical knowledge of machine learning or artificial intelligence is not required, but basic familiarity with how AI systems work will help participants get the most from the scenario-based exercises, case studies and peer collaboration throughout the two-day program.
How many CPE credits does the ISC2 Securing AI Workshop provide?
Participants earn 16 CPE credits toward maintaining ISC2 certifications such as CISSP, CCSP and SSCP. Virtual participants earn 10 CPE credits. All attendees receive a certificate of completion and a digital Credly badge upon finishing the workshop. ISC2 member credits are typically added to profiles within 7 to 10 working days after the event.
What is the format of the Securing AI Workshop?
The ISC2 Securing AI Workshop is a facilitator-led, interactive learning experience built around scenario-based exercises, real-world case studies and guided peer discussions. Rather than traditional lectures, the workshop emphasizes strategic problem-solving, practical decision-making and collaborative learning. Participants work through AI security scenarios drawn from industries including healthcare, financial services, energy and defense.
What topics does the ISC2 Securing AI Workshop cover?
Day 1 covers the fundamentals of AI and cybersecurity, core AI types and technologies, real-world applications of AI across industries such as banking, healthcare, retail, automotive, energy, agriculture and military, and an overview of the AI lifecycle. Day 2 focuses on AI security frameworks and standards, AI-specific threats and controls, AI security defenses including securing AI systems across the full lifecycle, and AI ethics and the future of artificial intelligence.
What do participants receive after completing the workshop?
Participants leave the ISC2 Securing AI Workshop with CPE credits (16 in-person or 10 virtual), a certificate of completion and a digital Credly badge. Beyond credentials, attendees gain practical knowledge for building an AI security roadmap, aligning AI practices with established risk management frameworks and implementing secure-by-design and secure-by-default principles across the AI lifecycle.
